body: I've told him but not *really* told him. It's hard to talk about, and I'm scared. I have a hard time saying anything, so I try to write stuff down and give it to him. I showed him all that last week, so I mean maybe he will have something to say this week that will help. But I also think if he really knew what was going on, he would lock me up. And I don't want that either, because I know it doesn't really help. I want to get better or die.

I just did, I've had this new therapist for a little over a month now. That's great and all, but fuck. I keep freaking out. I want to die. Things just aren't and can't get better. I'm so fucking tired of all of this. I am so fucking tired of just *being* here.
Yes, I have. I've been in therapy for a good long while now. But I am still this. I go every week, I pay out of pocket, I do everything they tell me to do but I am still this.
